# RGS Dev animated stick-figure character

- Source: https://rgsdev.itch.io/animated-stick-figure-character-2d-free-cc0
- Author: Raphael Gonçalves / RGS_Dev
- Downloaded: 2026-08-29
- License: CC0; see the included `Stick Figure Character Sprites 2D/License.txt`

The runtime importer uses the baked Sword and Pistol PNG sequences plus the
included bullet sprite. It scales and root-aligns them onto the game's existing
512 by 512 player canvas.
